method: Compares each person's post-flight urine values with that person's own preflight values (L-92, L-44, L-3).
NPQ is already log2. Change_log2 = NPQ minus baseline; Fold_change = 2^Change_log2.
Mean NPQ of that person's detected preflight samples (2 or 3 samples).
Baseline ± the larger of 1.0 log2 (2-fold) or 3 × typical within-person preflight variation for that analyte (pooled across all 4 people, floor 0.3, widened for baseline size).
Outside the range before OR after sample-level adjustment (possible dilution effect), or a moderate change (|z| ≥ 2 and ≥ 2-fold). Confirm before acting.
Outside the personal range both before and after sample-level adjustment.
Value not detected, or baseline had fewer than 2 detected values. Neither safe nor alarming.
Change after subtracting that sample's median shift across all analytes. Guards against whole-sample dilution/concentration changes.
Labels describe change versus the person's own baseline. They are not clinical reference ranges or a diagnosis.
Filter Results_long by Person + Analyte; plot Day (x) vs NPQ (y), with Normal_low and Normal_high as band lines.
notes: Outside range only before sample-level adjustment (possible dilution effect)
Outside personal range, also after sample-level adjustment
Baseline has fewer than 2 detected values
